title: Tool 调用、结果与失败语义
scope: Claude Code 2.1.226、Codex 0.147.0、OpenCode 1.18.15 的 effective catalog、call identity、native lifecycle、semantic outcome、side effect、retry 与 terminal reconciliation。

unknowns.title: 跨provider/build的schema version negotiation
unknowns.text: 跨provider/build的schema version negotiation：三家都没有统一public per-tool schema version/hash协商。
unknowns.needed: 保存每次effective catalog hash；unknown fields保留；source/effective schema分存。

unknowns.title: Claude terminal_reason exact 2.1.226 floor与值全集
unknowns.text: Claude terminal_reason exact 2.1.226 floor与值全集：只有live reference充分。
unknowns.needed: optional + open enum；以Result subtype/is_error与drain为主，不伪装exact field。

unknowns.title: lossless OS stdout/stderr ordering、bytes与encoding fidelity
unknowns.text: lossless OS stdout/stderr ordering、bytes与encoding fidelity：Claude/OpenCode已合并，Codex public mapping有损。
unknowns.needed: 不逆向恢复pipes；需要时接lower-level native capture并标surface。

unknowns.title: output/schema caps、config override与跨版本稳定性
unknowns.text: output/schema caps、config override与跨版本稳定性：当前数字多是实现default，不是协议常量。
unknowns.needed: cap/omitted/truncated/retention全部随receipt记录，绝不写死成兼容保证。

unknowns.title: 统一tool retry count/backoff不存在
unknowns.text: 统一tool retry count/backoff不存在：model、API/provider、sandbox replay、MCP/server、host retry各自独立。
unknowns.needed: 层级化attemptScope；未配置时禁止host自动retry有side effect的call。

unknowns.title: crash/reconnect后的exactly-once与call dedup
unknowns.text: crash/reconnect后的exactly-once与call dedup：没有跨host/process通用保证。

unknowns.title: 并发最大值、fairness、start/completion order与resource isolation
unknowns.text: 并发最大值、fairness、start/completion order与resource isolation：只证明部分overlap/lock/barrier。
unknowns.needed: timestamps和admission reason全量保存；不对UI order赋因果。

unknowns.title: cancellation atomicity与child process/remote action真正停止时点。
unknowns.text: cancellation atomicity与child process/remote action真正停止时点。
unknowns.needed: ACK后仍标effect_unknown；等待native terminal并执行domain reconciliation。

unknowns.title: background work跨query end、app restart、thread unload与系统休眠后的保留/回收。
unknowns.text: background work跨query end、app restart、thread unload与系统休眠后的保留/回收。
unknowns.needed: child/process inventory持久化；restart后主动list/GET/rejoin，不凭missing notification重启。

unknowns.title: denial provenance跨public surfaces的可靠度
unknowns.text: denial provenance跨public surfaces的可靠度：internal taxonomy、Declined、typed permission errors不能一概证明human action。
unknowns.needed: provenance使用unknown / user / policy / auto open enum；原始decision/error保留。

unknowns.title: MCP server自己的retry、transaction commit、idempotency key与compensation。
unknowns.text: MCP server自己的retry、transaction commit、idempotency key与compensation。
unknowns.needed: runtime只记录application/transport receipt；server-specific policy插件化。

unknowns.title: readOnlyHint真实性与本次执行实际effect。
unknowns.text: readOnlyHint真实性与本次执行实际effect。
unknowns.needed: 只用于展示/capability/admission；不调整审计结论或默认retry安全级。

unknowns.title: file atomicity/durability与external editor/cross-process race。
unknowns.needed: no-guarantee标记；对高风险操作保存pre/post hash、diff与durability receipt。

unknowns.title: async/delegated work的durable delivery guarantee
unknowns.text: async/delegated work的durable delivery guarantee：launch/submit成功不证明recipient消费，parent结束/压缩后notification是否必达未知。
unknowns.needed: child link持久化；delivery与completion各有receipt；missing terminal只显示unknown。

unknowns.title: telemetry/event delivery、secret redaction与trailing-frame全集
unknowns.text: telemetry/event delivery、secret redaction与trailing-frame全集：correlation字段不等exactly-once，raw exception/output/hook/task files没有统一scrub边界。
unknowns.needed: telemetry非terminal truth；raw content按surface做redaction；unknown late/trailing event保存并告警。

unknowns.title: Provider-executed tool 是否继承 local tool 控制面
unknowns.text: OpenCode 会标记 providerExecuted，但 permission、before/after hook、retention 与 local tool 是否等价并无通用保证。
unknowns.needed: 按 provider 做 conformance fixture；默认把 local permission/hook/retention 标为 unknown，而不是继承。

unknowns.title: pending.raw 不累积是合同还是实现遗漏
unknowns.text: OpenCode schema 保留 pending.raw，但 1.18.15 processor 没有稳定累积 provider argument delta；不能把空值宣传成跨版本保证。
unknowns.needed: 捕获多个 provider 的 input-stream fixture，并跟踪后续版本是否开始填充 raw；UI 仅显示参数生成中。
